∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                    ∀ (batch : ℕ),
                      have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                      (Measurable fun z => outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∧
                        (∀ᵐ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) ∂P,
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch →
                              ∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch j).isSome = true) ∧
                          ∀ (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                            MeasurableSet E →
                              (∀ z ∈ E, outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch) →
                                ∀ (v : Fin q.S → Fin q.m),
                                  P
                                      (E ∩
                                        {z |
                                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch = fun j =>
                                            some (v j)}) =
                                    P E * (↑q.m ^ q.S)⁻¹
